newsitem.title: UK: UK meal and feeds firm, attract routine trade.
newsitem.headline: UK meal and feeds firm, attract routine trade.

text.p: Higher prices were not enough to turn buyers away from the UK meals and feeds market on Tuesday.
High protein soymeal sellers were as much as three stg a tonne up, but buyers were still showing some interest.
High protein soymeal fetched 212 stg a tonne on the East Coast with brokers reporting a good tonnage changing hands.
On the south coast 217 stg was paid for spot high pro ex-store.
Cargill rapemeal from the Liverpool mill traded at 123 stg for spot.
However, later higher Chicago futures sidelined many buyers with sellers running away as sterling lost ground against the dollar.
